_doc: P5 plan v2 B00-S (ZERO_SHOT_P5_STRICT): flow_p5_final in mode H (hide_api industry: no hand-written business functions) with Qwen3.5-9B base weights (soup_job --adapters NONE: no V3A), no W LoRA (links_lora / judge_lora empty: WL1, WJR1 off) and NO rule cache from tuned models: the shipped public cards (compile_public_b, alias_public) and the train-induced / translit cards are dropped; lrl_regen 1 = W1 bind + aliases rewritten for the split by the same base model at inference (compile_train.jsonl is listed only to switch the card layer on: cards of another rulebook are discarded by prepare_lrl).
